## Summary

Describe what changes and why.

## Release impact

Select exactly one option. The pull request title must match the selected impact.

- [ ] none — internal work, research, documentation, tests, or automation
- [ ] patch — fixes observable production behavior
- [ ] minor — adds a new usable product capability
- [ ] breaking — introduces an explicitly approved incompatibility

## Validation

- [ ] I tested the affected flow.
- [ ] I ran lint, type checks, and relevant tests.
- [ ] I documented migrations, risks, or manual steps when applicable.
